message.cassino.slot.jackpot_broadcast: %s hit the JACKPOT and won %s chips!
gui.cassino.slot.paytable: Pays on the middle line: 3, 4 or 5 in a row from the left (times the bet)
gui.cassino.slot.tip.deposit: Deposits the chips in the slot next to it: each chip becomes 1 credit. Credits are yours only, work on any slot machine and stay saved when you close it
gui.cassino.slot.tip.withdraw: Cashes out all your credits as chips
gui.cassino.slot.paytable.jackpot: Jackpot (five 7s): 100x + %s%% of the house pool with a bet of %s (smaller bets get a proportional part)
gui.cassino.blackjack.title: Blackjack
gui.cassino.blackjack.tip.rules: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Blackjack (an Ace + a 10-value card as the first two) pays 3:2, a win pays 1:1 and a tie returns the bet. The dealer draws to 17.
gui.cassino.blackjack.tip.double: Doubles the bet, takes exactly one more card and stands (first two cards only)
gui.cassino.blackjack.table_closed: The table is out of funds.
gui.cassino.roulette.title: Roulette
gui.cassino.roulette.rule: Click a color to bet on it
gui.cassino.roulette.tip.rules: The wheel has 37 pockets: 18 red, 18 black and the green 0. Red or black pays back 2x the bet; green pays back 36x. Click one of the colors on the table to choose your bet.
gui.cassino.race.title: Horse Betting
gui.cassino.race.tip.rules: Click a horse to bet on it and press RACE!. If it wins, the bet comes back multiplied by the value under its name. The horses and their chances change every Minecraft day.
message.cassino.race.longshot: %s won %s chips betting on the long shot %s (x%s)!
gui.cassino.house.tip: House balance: how much the casino has won on this server, across all games. From +640 up, the odds of winning rise step by step in every game, to give the chips back to the players.
gui.cassino.exchanger.title: Chip Exchanger
gui.cassino.exchanger.tip.buy: Trades the gold and diamond in the slots for chips: 8 gold ingots + 1 diamond = 4 chips, as many times as they allow. The chips go to your inventory, and whatever is left stays in the slot.
gui.cassino.exchanger.tip.sell: Trades the chips in the slot for gold and diamonds: 4 chips = 8 gold ingots + 1 diamond, as many times as they allow. The gold and diamonds go to your inventory, and leftover chips (fewer than 4) stay in the slot.
gui.cassino.dice.title: Dice Game
gui.cassino.dice.tip.rules: Two dice are rolled, and the bet is on the total (2 to 12). Click a row to pick the bet: if it hits, it pays that row's prize.
gui.cassino.dice.tip.0: EVEN: wins if the total is even. Comes up %2$s times in 36. Pays %3$s.
gui.cassino.dice.tip.1: ODD: wins if the total is odd. Comes up %2$s times in 36. Pays %3$s.
gui.cassino.dice.tip.2: NUMBER: wins if the total is exactly %1$s. Comes up %2$s times in 36. Pays %3$s.
gui.cassino.dice.tip.3: LOW: wins if the total is 2 to 6. Comes up %2$s times in 36. Pays %3$s.
gui.cassino.dice.tip.4: HIGH: wins if the total is 8 to 12. Comes up %2$s times in 36. Pays %3$s.
gui.cassino.dice.tip.number_box: The number for the NUMBER bet (2 to 12). Click to raise it, right-click to lower it, or use the mouse wheel. The harder the number, the more it pays.
gui.cassino.coin.title: Heads or Tails
gui.cassino.coin.result.edge: The coin landed on its edge! The house wins.
gui.cassino.coin.tip.rules: Pick HEADS or TAILS and flip the coin: a hit pays 2x the bet. Once in 25 flips the coin lands on its edge, and the house wins.
gui.cassino.dice.hint: Pick a bet and roll the dice
gui.cassino.plinko.title: Slime Plinko
gui.cassino.plinko.tip.rules: The slime ball leaves the funnel and bounces off the pegs, left or right, until it falls into one of the slots below. Each slot multiplies the bet: 10x on the ends (1 in 64 each), 2x, 0.5x and 0.2x in the middle (the easiest).
gui.cassino.lottery.title: Mob Lottery
gui.cassino.lottery.tip.bet: Bets %s chips on the chosen mob (one bet per day). When the Minecraft day ends, a mob is drawn: whoever picked it splits the pot. If nobody wins, the pot carries over to the next day.
gui.cassino.lottery.hint: Pick a mob and bet %s chips
gui.cassino.lottery.already: You already bet today. Come back tomorrow!
message.cassino.lottery.draw.none: %s %s was drawn! Nobody won: the pot is now %s chips.
message.cassino.lottery.won.title: YOU WON!
message.cassino.lottery.won.subtitle: +%s chips in the Mob Lottery
message.cassino.lottery.won.chat: You won %s chips in the Mob Lottery! They are already in your casino credits.
